verdict.rationale: pnpm's docs explicitly describe a content-addressable store where files are hard-linked, so multiple projects on the same dependency version share one copy on disk, and community reports independently corroborate the resulting disk-space savings. This is a core, well-documented pnpm feature with both first-party and hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark/measurement of actual dedup ratio beyond anecdotal community praise.
